newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-EURO 96 TOPPED THE ITALIAN TELEVISION RATINGS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-EURO 96 TOPPED THE ITALIAN TELEVISION RATINGS.

text.p: Italy's poor showing in the 1996 European soccer championship still drew more television viewers than any other programme broadcast during the year.

Auditel figures released on Tuesday showed that Euro '96 matches played in England in June occupied two of the top three places in the ratings. The other was the European Cup final played in Rome in May and won by Italy's Juventus.
Italy against Germany, a match that ended Italy's championship hopes, drew an audience of 22.1 million while the Juventus v Ajax final was watched by just over 19 million.
The third most popular programme was the Czech Republic v Italy match, watched by 18 million people.

Two other European Cup soccer matches appeared in the top 10 listings -- French club Nantes v Juventus in April drew 12.9 million for ninth place while Juventus against Spain's Real Madrid in March drew 12.8 million for 10th.
